title: Shellshocking OpenVPN servers
guide_zh: 某些 OpenVPN 配置会调用自定义脚本，作者提醒它们可能受 Shellshock 影响。
author: kfreds
excerpt: OpenVPN servers are vulnerable to Shellshock under certain configurations. OpenVPN has a number of configuration options that can call custom commands during different stages of the tunnel session. Many of these commands are called with environmental variables set, some of which can be controlled by the client. One option used for username+password authentication is "auth-user-pass-verify".
